header_clutter.issue: Live crypto price ticker under nav clutters header.

hero_section.issue: 4-line headline, overly long paragraph, muddy gold background blob, floating overlapping cards.
hero_section.fix: Replace with Bybit-tier crisp hero: (1) Headline max 2 lines: 'Accept Crypto Everywhere. Settle Directly to Your Wallet.' (2) Action flow ribbon: 'Accept · Convert · Settle · Withdraw' with subtle dividers. (3) Prominent Sign-up Box containing quick email input + 'Start Free' CTA + 'Continue with Google' button routing to /auth/register?ref=hero&provider=google + 3 trust checkmarks. (4) Right visual: Sleek integrated hosted-checkout mockup card with live QR code, asset selection, payment amount in USD/BTC, and real-time transaction stepper without chaotic overlapping floating badges.

product_showcase.issue: Left interactive tab list left right dark visual panel 70% empty.
product_showcase.fix: Convert to Bybit-style 'One platform, endless possibilities' 4-card interactive bento grid (Accept Payments, Auto-Convert Engine, Direct Settlement, Hosted Links & Invoices). Each card features rich dark surface styling (#1A1A19), gold glowing subtle borders on hover, dynamic visual illustrations (interactive QR engine, live exchange rate simulator preview, multi-chain settlement routing graph, and live payment link generator preview) filling 100% of internal container space.

how_it_works.fix: Rebuild as interactive 3-step connected workflow pipeline (1. Connect API / Create Link -> 2. Customer Pays in 40+ Assets -> 3. Instant Settlement to Merchant Wallet). Include progressive active state highlighting, step numbers in gold mono pill, and mini live interaction per step.

app_showcase.issue: Fake App Store / Google Play badges for non-existent mobile app.
app_showcase.fix: Replace entirely with 'Works on Every Device' section showcasing responsive Web Dashboard on desktop alongside Mobile-Web browser mockup. Highlight responsive web features (PWA, web links, merchant terminal) with NO store badges.

trust_and_metrics.fix: Use real live metrics endpoint GET /api/status/landing-metrics (payments_settled_this_month ~1,021, countries_served 121, uptime_90d_pct 99.94%, 40+ supported assets across 8 chains, 1.5% starting fee, zero chargeback guarantee).

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Remove the price ticker band beneath the main nav bar to eliminate header clutter.
2. Standardize all primary call-to-action buttons with DynoPay Gold (#FFD100) background, bold dark text (#1A1A19), full rounded pill geometry (rounded-full), and subtle hover state (#E6BC00).

3. On the hero section, maintain a crisp 2-line title, action flow ribbon, and sign-up form with both 'Start Free' and 'Continue with Google' button pointing to /auth/register?ref=hero&provider=google.
4. Ensure right side hero hosted checkout mockup is self-contained with live QR code, asset selection, amount display, and status stepper.
5. Populate the live metrics bar with data fetched from GET /api/status/landing-metrics or fallback constants.
6. Build the 'One Platform' section as 4 interactive dark-panel cards with gold hover borders and visual diagrams filling card height.
7. Replace fake mobile app download badges with 'Works on Every Device' featuring desktop dashboard and mobile web mockups.
8. Include exact data-testid attributes on all buttons, inputs, links, metric items, and sections as defined in blueprint.
